test_title: PYST 07: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the left of H. Only four people sit between H and F. Only three people sit to the right of N. K sits to the immediate left of L. G is not an immediate neighbour of N. Who sits fourth to the left of G?
solution:
Given:

Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north.

No one sits to the left of H. Only four people sit between H and F.

Only three people sit to the right of N. K sits to the immediate left of L.

G is not an immediate neighbour of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ec81c8d08be79fb6bd0b7c6b7f3301774f5398659b43c999afb26fb9bb87adc.png] 

Thus, 'L' sits fourth to the left of G..

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
